thread:
alex: seeing a bunch of private cluster dashboards with gaps for tenant=acme-inc, started ~09:10 UTC after the authz swap. charts show blank series instead of zeros. anyone else? :eyes:

maria: yep, reports from a customer. console shows requests in the access logs, but tenant-specific metrics not showing up in the time series.

julien: quick check — are the tenant headers still making it to the metrics pipeline? last week we changed the auth proxy to use authorization header forwarding.

alex: here's a curl from inside the private gateway pod showing the header present on ingress ->
```
curl -sv -H 'x-tenant-id: acme-inc' https://localhost/health --insecure
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: localhost
> x-tenant-id: acme-inc
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
But downstream (sidecar -> metrics-agent) we only see requests without x-tenant-id. logs attached: `sidecar.log` shows `tenant: null` lines.

ops-jen: I just pulled the envoy config from the private gateway. I see a route-level `strip_headers` entry for `x-tenant-id` that was added by the new authz filter.

maria: ahhh — customer uses header-based tenant routing for metrics. If the authz swap added a strip header for authorization, it might have accidentally included the tenant header. Can we confirm which change rolled at 09:05?

julien: rolling log shows deploy `authz-proxy:v2.7.1` at 09:04:12. Release notes mention "remove sensitive headers from forwarded request". Looks like rule used a glob and matched `x-*` unintentionally.

alex: repro steps I ran:
1) send a request with `x-tenant-id`
2) check sidecar logs — header missing
3) check metrics agent payloads — `tenant` field absent

I can paste short logs if helpful.

maria: please paste one example of the metrics ingestion payload (sanitized). we need to know if the tenant is dropped before batching or stripped by the agent.

alex: snippet from metrics-agent.out showing batch without tenant:
```
{"metric":"tokens_generated","value":12,"tenant":null,"model":"redwood-2"}
```

ops-jen: timeline wise: authz proxy deploy -> envoy config rewrite -> headers stripped -> sidecar receives headerless requests -> metrics pipeline keys by tenant -> time series not written -> dashboards blank. makes sense.

julien: workaround: update envoy route to stop stripping `x-tenant-id` and redeploy. I can cut a patch now. But we should be careful to keep `Authorization` stripped.

maria: agreed. Can we also add a regression test to the authz change that fails if any `x-tenant-` header is removed?

alex: customer impact: missing metrics for last ~30m, billing and usage dashboards under-reporting. flagged as high. I notified support-bot to open incident ticket.

support-bot: Incident #INC-2026-381 opened for missing tenant metrics (private cluster). Severity: P2.

julien: cut a hotfix branch and a small envoy patch to whitelist tenant headers. patch deploy in 5m to the canary private region.

ops-jen: canary rolled at 09:22 to one gateway instance. verified sidecar logs now show `tenant: acme-inc` on new requests. metrics ingestion showing tenant in payload.

maria: can we backfill the 30m of missing points or at least mark charts as partial? Backfill might be tricky if tenant wasn't included in payloads.

julien: backfill option: metrics agent still logged each request locally with tenant on some nodes prior to full rollout? unlikely. We should add a dashboard annotation indicating the authz change window + a note that tenant-level data may be incomplete. Ops will run a sweep to see if any agents recorded the header.

alex: for remediation checklist:
- [x] identify strip_headers rule causing drop
- [x] patch to whitelist `x-tenant-id` and `x-tenant-*`
- [x] canary deploy + verify sidecar logs
- [ ] run cluster sweep to find nodes missing tenant header logs
- [ ] add regression test to authz PR
- [ ] notify customer and update incident

maria: thanks team. julien/ops-jen please add the envoy config diff here once available and tag me. I'll handle customer comms and dashboard annotation. :thumbsup:

julien: envoy diff pasted:
```
- strip_headers: ["authorization", "x-tenant-id"]
+ strip_headers: ["authorization"]
+ allowed_headers: ["x-tenant-id", "x-tenant-region"]
```

ops-jen: note: we'll rotate the authz image to v2.7.1-hotfix with the change. scheduled complete rollback window 10:15 if anything flares.

alex: customer confirmed dashboards populated after the hotfix canary. marking this thread as actionable for a follow-up postmortem.

support-bot: Incident #INC-2026-381 updated: hotfix deployed to canary, monitoring.

julien: creating a short PR with the regression test and config linting rule — will link when ready.

maria: awesome. I'll close the customer loop once backfill decision made.
